text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Daring Heart—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Look at that, Trainer! There are so 
many cute girls!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Daring Heart pointed, there 
was a crane game filled with plushies 
designed after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: You really like Paka Petits, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, surprised? I don't play much myself, 
but I actually receive quite a lot as 
presents.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And keeping it in my room like that, I've 
grown kind of attached to it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's quite lovely, really, feeling 
surrounded by so many children even after 
returning to my room.
choice_data_list: Then let me give you a present too!

In that case, let me give you a present 
too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You've got a point! Well then, 
let's see what you've got. Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
